question: Which of the following molecules participates in the extravasation of the T lymphocytes to the target tissue ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Selectin L" -> facilitates rolling of T lymphocytes on endothelial cells -> promotes T lymphocyte extravasation to target tissue -> 85%
CHAIN: "IFN-gamma" -> enhances T lymphocyte activation -> does not directly participate in extravasation -> 70%
CHAIN: "CD3" -> part of the T cell receptor complex -> essential for T cell activation -> not directly involved in extravasation -> 75%
CHAIN: "Molecules belonging to the MHC" -> present antigens to T lymphocytes -> crucial for T cell recognition -> not directly involved in extravasation -> 80%
analysis: In the extravasation process of T lymphocytes to target tissues, Selectin L plays a crucial role by mediating the initial rolling of T cells along the endothelium.
